label: Synthetic face D
description: Light skin, about 40. Very subtle freckling: the fine-skin example.
alt: Synthetic portrait of a woman in her forties with light skin and very faint freckles, looking straight at the camera.

skipped.reason: mask is empty: no redness zones were found
a sampling window, not a visible mark; used only as the skin reference area

dark_circle.headline: Under-eye shadows carry far, on every face.
dark_circle.detail: Under-eye shadows are a large, soft area; on everyone, they're among the last things to fade with distance. That says how big the area is, not how much there is.

eye_bag.headline: Under-eye puffiness carries far, on every face.
eye_bag.detail: Under-eye puffiness is a large, soft area; on everyone, it's among the last things to fade with distance. That says how big the area is, not how much there is.

wrinkle.headline: Some of your fine lines can be seen from across a table.
wrinkle.detail: A typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could pick out some of your fine lines from across a table. From across a room, a few could still be picked out.

age_spot.headline: Most of your dark spots can be seen from across a table.
age_spot.detail: A typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could pick out most of your dark spots from across a table. From across a room, a small share could still be picked out. See the lightest touch that puts them out of sight, on a virtual try-on. This measures how visible a mark is, not what it is. If one is new, changing or worrying you, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
age_spot.safety: This measures how visible a mark is, not what it is. If one is new, changing or worrying you, ask a doctor or pharmacist.

pore.headline: A few of your pores can be seen from across a table.
pore.detail: A typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could pick out a few of your pores from across a table. See the lightest touch that puts them out of sight, on a virtual try-on.

acne.headline: Your breakouts can be picked out from about 1.7 m.
acne.detail: That's across a table, for a typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them. This one is a rough estimate: the range is about 2.4–2.6 m. See the lightest touch that puts them out of sight, on a virtual try-on. This measures how visible a mark is, not what it is. If one is new, changing or worrying you, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
acne.safety: This measures how visible a mark is, not what it is. If one is new, changing or worrying you, ask a doctor or pharmacist.

dark_circle.headline: A large, soft area shows even a small change.
dark_circle.detail: Because it's a large area, even a small change can be seen from a distance. If your under-eye shadows looked noticeably lighter (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical person could tell the difference on any face.

eye_bag.headline: A large, soft area shows even a small change.
eye_bag.detail: Because it's a large area, even a small change can be seen from a distance. If your under-eye puffiness looked noticeably smoother (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical person could tell the difference on any face.

wrinkle.headline: The change could show on some of your fine lines.
wrinkle.detail: If your fine lines looked noticeably softer (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could see the difference on some of your fine lines from across a table.

age_spot.headline: The change could show on a small share of your dark spots.
age_spot.detail: If your dark spots looked noticeably lighter (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could see the difference on a small share of your dark spots from across a table.

pore.headline: The change could show on a few of your pores.
pore.detail: If your pores looked noticeably softer (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could see the difference on a few of your pores from across a table.

acne.headline: The change could show from about 1.5 m.
acne.detail: If your breakouts looked noticeably fainter (YouCam Skin Simulation, half strength), a typical sharp-eyed person looking right at them could see the difference from about 1.5 m, across a table.

sentences.summary: From a metre away, a typical sharp-eyed person could pick out your under-eye shadows and under-eye puffiness.
